item: L2-1 whether the non-root user has sudo
why: "as a non-root user" is meant to catch steps that silently assume root. With passwordless sudo, steps that say `sudo ...` work and steps that write to system paths without sudo fail; without sudo, every step that needs root fails. setup_user.sh supports both (GRANT_SUDO=yes|no).

candidates.source: setup_user.sh GRANT_SUDO=yes (recommended: a typical developer account can sudo)
